# The palette's themes start at the theme in use and try nothing out until
# you move: the half of theme = light:probe-theme,dark:Libertty Dark that the
# appearance picks (tests/run.sh gives it a config of its own: probe-theme's
# background is #112233).
appearance:light
wait:0.4
expect-background:#112233
# The Themes chip (Tab walks the chips): on probe-theme, the windows as they were.
key:cmd+shift+p
wait:0.4
key:tab
key:tab
key:tab
key:tab
key:tab
key:tab
key:tab
wait:0.4
expect-scope:[Themes]
expect-palette-selected:Theme: probe-theme
expect-background:#112233
# ↑ tries the one above.
key:up
wait:0.4
expect-palette-selected:Theme:
key:escape
wait:0.4
expect-background:#112233
# Change Theme… starts there too (its row checked), trying nothing either.
key:cmd+shift+p
wait:0.4
type:change theme
wait:0.3
key:enter
wait:0.4
expect-palette-selected:probe-theme
expect-background:#112233
key:escape
wait:0.3
key:escape
wait:0.4
# Dark: the pair's other half is the one in use.
appearance:dark
wait:0.4
expect-background:#1c1c1e
key:cmd+shift+p
wait:0.4
type:change theme
wait:0.3
key:enter
wait:0.4
expect-palette-selected:Libertty Dark
expect-background:#1c1c1e
key:down
wait:0.4
expect-background:#faf9f6
key:escape
wait:0.3
expect-background:#1c1c1e
key:escape
wait:0.3
